name: Nem nướng
summary: Grilled pork rolled in bánh tráng phơi sương with fresh herbs and a dipping sauce each shop mixes itself. At bà Hùng the pork is lean.
origin: Da Lat nem nướng, a different plate from the one other cities serve.
howToEat: The rolls come with bánh tráng phơi sương and fresh herbs, and the sauce is mixed in the shop.
Bà Nghĩa also sells bánh xèo and chả giò, as separate plates.
where: Nem nướng bà Hùng, 5 Trần Phú. Nem nướng bà Nghĩa, 45 Bùi Thị Xuân.
priceBand: 45,000 VND a portion at bà Hùng; 45,000–70,000 VND at bà Nghĩa (Visit Lâm Đồng).
seoDescription: Grilled pork rolled in bánh tráng phơi sương with fresh herbs and a dipping sauce each shop mixes itself. At bà Hùng the pork is lean.
